goal: Persist an immutable source-checked full prebar state for inventory, active and pending stops, TP1/TP2 state, funded IOC reservations, explicit all-generated opportunities including REFUSED/NO_FILL, and independently verifiable missing-bar/restart hash-chain gates WITHOUT viewing current bar OHLC, generating signals or accounts.

exact_input.bar_start: planned 5-minute bar start; no bar.h,bar.l,bar.c or current open allowed
exact_input.public_information: only completed prior bars with source availableAt <= barStart
exact_input.portfolio: one funded account physical cash/equity with explicit knownAt, no rehypothecation and no second shadow starting bankroll
exact_input.reservations: original full HARPOON_FUNDED_RESERVATIONS_1 book passed to snapshotFundedReservations; reject observations with knownAt beyond current bar start rather than silently slicing them
exact_input.positions: every open long lot, entryPrice, entryAt, quantity and original admission reservation ID; stop price, stopKnownAt and pending future stop; TP1/TP2 price, quantity, done, knownAt; 72h deadline
exact_input.candidate_universe: list of enumerated source candidate IDs with declared generator hash plus exact one outcome each; REFUSED has reason; RESERVED must bind original reservation; NO_SIGNAL supported, no futures.
exact_input.coverage: expected five-minute scheduled bar starts externally supplied; require all frames and no duplicate timestamps/keys before claiming complete
exact_input.storage: private local new-files-only append-only SHA256 chain, mode0700 dir and 0600 files; no compressed temporary byte hiding or postdating frames
exact_input.complete_roll_accountability: real count of source generated candidates, refused reasons, cancellations and NO_FILL observations retained; source declaration cannot be treated as completeness proof absent instrumentation at generator
exact_input.clock: all knownAt fields <=barStart, internal event at<=knownAt and published prior marks; exact numeric safe millisecond epoch for M9 synthetic source; future journal may use C26 nanosecond source
exact_input.provenance: byte hash is reproducibility, NOT independent broker authenticity or proof event was captured at claimed time

falsifiers: Prebar snapshot includes any current-bar high, low, close or future open
KnownAt of stop, TP, opportunity or reservation observation after barStart
Position qty differs from source OPENED reservation remaining, or position missing for OPENED reservation
Target marked done then reverts to undone, stop tightened based on future data, pending stop effective before known
NO_FILL/CLOSED released before their knownAt; delayed fill/reject becomes backward-funded entry
Rejected opportunity lacks explicit reason, source generated candidate has no outcome or duplicate ID
One planned 5-minute bar absent, duplicated, out-of-order, or journal hash altered
Restart resumes without independently checking all immutable previous frames
Account marked wealth differs from cash plus funded marks within tolerance, negative funded cash or double initial capital
Original 12% admission cap recast as continuous 12% liquidation
Offline local content digest promoted to exchange- or broker-origin authentication
Any new market seed, signal nomination, economic account, private paper/live order, M10 final member read, deploy or merge

success.software: Source-frozen snapshot + immutable restart proof + missing bar and adversarial finance/receipt tests PASS
success.economic_certification: BLOCKED until independently authenticated origin/complete live coverage and reached price/fills; C27 itself does not create real data
